question: The Aitareya Upanishad belongs to fourth, fifth and sixth chapters of the second book of Aitareya Aranyaka of the ________ and considered as the oldest Upanishads.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rig Veda**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Aitareya Upanishad** is associated with the **Rig Veda**.
 
• It is found in the fourth, fifth, and sixth chapters of the second book of the Aitareya Aranyaka.
 
• The Aitareya Upanishad is considered one of the **oldest Upanishads**.
 
• It primarily deals with the philosophical concepts of the self and the universe.
 
• The teachings in this Upanishad are delivered through various narratives and metaphysical discussions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Upanishads** are a collection of ancient Sanskrit texts that contain some of the central philosophical concepts and ideas of Hinduism.
 
• They are considered the end part of the Vedas and are sometimes referred to as Vedanta, meaning the conclusion of the Vedas.
 
• There are more than 200 known Upanishads, but the principal Upanishads, including the Aitareya, are the most important and influential.
 
• The Rig Veda, to which the Aitareya Upanishad belongs, is one of the oldest known texts in human history, dating back to the early Vedic period.
